$regime.title: Tax Regime
$regime.description:
Country code that identifies the tax regime applicable to the document.
It determines which country-specific tax rules, normalizations, and validations are applied.
It may be determined automatically via normalization of a supplier or issuer tax identity
country code.

$addons.title: Addons
$addons.description:
Keys identifying the tax addons that apply special normalization, scenarios, and
validation rules to the document.

$tags.title: Tags
$tags.description:
Keys that identify specific tax scenarios or requirements that may change the
contents of the document or imply a specific meaning. Converters may use tags to
identify situations that do not have a specific extension; for example, self-billed
or partial invoices are identified by their respective tags.

oneOf.title: Delivery Advice
oneOf.description:
A delivery or despatch advice document send by the supplier to indicate how
an order is to be delivered.

oneOf.title: Delivery Note
oneOf.description:
A delivery note is a document accompanying a shipment of goods that lists the
items included in the shipment.

oneOf.title: Waybill
oneOf.description:
A waybill is a document issued by a carrier giving details and instructions
relating to the shipment of a consignment of goods.

oneOf.title: Delivery Receipt
oneOf.description:
A delivery receipt is a document that is signed by the person who receives
goods to confirm that they have been received.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description:
Any other type of delivery that does not fit into the standard categories and implies
that any scenarios defined in tax regimes or addons will not be applied.

This is useful for being able to create deliveries with custom types in extensions,
but is not recommended for general use.

series.title: Series
series.description:
Identifies groups of deliveries by date, business area, project, type, customer,
a combination of any, or other company specific data. If the output format does not
support the series as a separate field, it will be prepended to the code with a dash
(`-`) for separation.

code.title: Code
code.description:
Sequential identifier that uniquely identifies the delivery. May be left empty
initially, but is **required** to **sign** the document.

issue_date.title: Issue Date
issue_date.description: When the delivery document is to be issued.

issue_time.title: Issue Time
issue_time.description:
Optional time of day when the delivery was issued. Some regions and formats may
require this field; otherwise it can be left nil.

value_date.title: Value Date
value_date.description: When the taxes of the delivery become accountable. Defaults to the issue date.

exchange_rates.title: Exchange Rates
exchange_rates.description: Exchange rates to be used when converting the document's monetary values into other currencies.

ordering.title: Ordering
ordering.description: Ordering details for the delivery, including links to other documents.

preceding.title: Preceding Details
preceding.description:
Key information regarding previous delivery documents that this one will either
extend or replace.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: Codes or IDs that may be used to identify and track the delivery.

despatch_date.title: Despatch Date
despatch_date.description: Date when the goods are expected to be despatched.

receive_date.title: Receive Date
receive_date.description: Date when the goods are expected to be received.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Special tax configuration for calculating totals.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: The entity supplying the goods or services and usually responsible for paying taxes.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Legal entity receiving the goods or services, may be nil in certain circumstances such as simplified invoices.

despatcher.title: Despatcher
despatcher.description: The party who will despatch the goods defined in the invoice.

receiver.title: Receiver
receiver.description: The party who will receive delivery of the goods defined in the invoice.

courier.title: Courier
courier.description: The courier responsible for delivering the goods.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: List of lines representing each of the items to be delivered.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Discounts or allowances applied to the delivery totals.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: Charges or surcharges applied to the delivery totals.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Summary of all the delivery totals, including taxes (calculated).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description:
Unstructured information that is relevant to the delivery, such as correction or additional
legal details.

complements.title: Complements
complements.description: Additional complementary objects that add relevant information to the delivery.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Additional semi-structured data that doesn't fit into the body of the delivery.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description:
Supporting documents that are not included in the main document. Do not use for
alternative versions of the PDF; use "links" inside the envelope headers instead.

bill.Delivery.description: Delivery document used to describe the delivery of goods or potentially also services.

code.title: Code
code.description: Code used to track the delivery.

website.title: Website
website.description: URL to access more tracking details.

bill.Tracking.description: Tracking stores tracking information about a delivery.
